title: Privacy Policy
note: The source WordPress site did not publish a privacy policy page (404). This policy describes how THIS redesign handles enquiry data.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Kitchen & Flooring Depot operates a showroom at 2434 Berlin Turnpike #7, Newington, CT 06111. Contact: hr@kitchenflooringdepot.com, (860) 757-3330.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: When you submit a quote or contact form we collect your name, email, phone, service interest, and project message. Optional fields such as area size or budget are stored only if you provide them.

sections.heading: How we use information
sections.body: We use enquiry details to respond to your request and follow up about design or installation services. We do not sell personal information.

sections.heading: Storage
sections.body: Enquiries are saved on the application server under a protected data directory before any email notification is attempted. Access should be limited to authorized staff and hosting operators.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: This site does not require marketing cookies for core browsing. If analytics or advertising cookies are added later, this policy should be updated before they are enabled.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For privacy questions, email hr@kitchenflooringdepot.com or call (860) 757-3330.
